model_binding_rule: Replay may report PARTIAL_UNVERIFIED/UNVERIFIED. Model-sensitive fresh evidence is non-promotable unless the private frozen execution manifest plus runtime receipt prove the predeclared observed model/reasoning/tools/environment binding; requested model text is not proof.
worker_write_rule: When candidate is inactive, write only preactivation/<candidate>/<role>.json on dedicated ps/preactivate branch after exact staged-manifest challenge. When active, read CURRENT then exact frozen G and write exactly reports/<cohort>/<role>.json on assigned production branch. Whole-report HMAC-2. No main writes.
verifier_write_rule: MM06 independently verifies preactivation scheduler admission before promotion, and after active worker deadline independently rereads all exact worker branches from G; production verification writes verification/<cohort>.json on ps/verify/<cohort> only.
integrator_write_rule: Require MM06 safe refs and source-bound supernova/report-admission=success on the exact verifier head; construct candidate in memory, validate live/schema/semantic bindings, then create once on ps/integrate/<cohort>.
director_write_rule: Stage successor and stop; promotion requires later admitted scheduler evidence and fresh scheduler readback. After verified integration create one ps/consolidate/<cohort> PR from exact current main. Require exact-head source-bound contexts and CAS; no force/rebase/bypass.
research_rule: BIL00 only at 00:58 and 12:58, and only when an accepted open research lane exists. While T0 is unqualified, T0 transport/repository/admission closure is the only admissible research lane; all other hourly BIL00 runs are director, liveness, issue-consolidation and guarded-repair runs.
